text:
mira: early-shift check-in — ran the nightly kernel batcher perf job against the new slot allocator patch. saw a p95 regression ~8% on 1k-token traces when KV cache is cold. putting notes here so folks can triage async. :thinking_face:

sam: got it, do you have the raw logs/artifacts? can you paste the perf snippet or link the run?

mira: pasted the short log below. full artifacts uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-ci/bench/2024-04-26/slot-alloc-v2

mira: ```
# summary (slot-alloc-v2 vs main)
- throughput: +3% overall
- p50: ~no change
- p95: +8% (regression) for 1k tokens, cold-KV runs only
- kv-miss-rate: unchanged

sample line:
[2024-04-26T04:12:02Z] trace_id=xyz p95=213ms -> 231ms (1k, cold)
```

chet: hmm. any diffs in batching windows or microbatch sizes? the allocator could be fragmenting batches under certain request size distributions.

mira: allocator changes mostly touch slot reuse heuristics. microbatch size target still 8, but observed more slot churn in the trace. attaching a small diff snippet: `if (slot.age > REUSE_AGE) mark_for_realloc()` — might be too aggressive.

anya: quick thought — could this be a KV prefetch timing issue? if slots get churned we might miss prefix cache warm paths and trigger extra KV roundtrips. can you grep for kv-prefetch timings in the logs?

mira: yes, grep shows a small bump in kv-fetch latency aligned with churn spikes. I'll add annotated flame graphs to the run artifacts.

sam: can you add a canary job that flips only `REUSE_AGE` back to previous value and run the same trace set? want to confirm causality. I can queue it now if you point me to the job id.

mira: queued: job 20240426-slot-alloc-reuseA. ETA ~25m. I'll post results when done.

deploy-bot: CI: Job 20240426-slot-alloc-reuseA started by @sam. Logs streaming: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/20240426-slot-alloc-reuseA

chet: also please add a quick microbenchmark with only KV-cache warm path (simulate cache hits) to rule out unrelated regressions. if warm path passes then allocator is the prime suspect.

mira: will do. plan for today: 1) run reuseA canary (in progress) 2) run KV-warm microbench 3) if both indicate allocator, open PR to relax `REUSE_AGE` and add unit test for slot churn. blockers: none besides waiting for the canary.

anya: thanks — ping me when the canary finishes and I'll take a look at flame graphs. happy to pair on the PR. :thumbsup:

sam: if canary confirms, we should also add a regression test in perf harness and a short alert if p95 goes > +5% from baseline for cold-KV traces.

mira: agreed. adding to my todo. will update thread with results.

deploy-bot: CI: Job 20240426-slot-alloc-reuseA completed (success). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/20240426-slot-alloc-reuseA/results

mira: canary result: p95 back to baseline after reverting `REUSE_AGE`. Looks like allocator is the cause. I'll open PR to adjust heuristic and include microbench.

chet: awesome, thanks for chasing. small nit — include the exact commit hashes and the trace id that repros so QE can lock it down.

mira: will do. closing this async check-in for now.
